raw_text: The user rejected "tension" as a drive name and chose "inference1/inference2" instead — a declaration act that affiliates infrastructure with project identity rather than inheriting overloaded LLM vocabulary. The friction_state driving this was naming contamination: tension carries LLM-generated resonance that would bleed into every reference to the backup system, conflating storage infrastructure with a conceptual category the project already owns. The harmony_restoration came through project-native naming that is self-documenting and carries no prior implicature. The underscore separator in inference_1 was further resolved on cooperative manner grounds — 1 and lowercase l are visually ambiguous — demonstrating that even infrastructure identifiers are subject to legibility pressure. This is a tribal authority move: the name earns its place by fitting the project's conceptual field rather than following an external convention.
